correctness.rationale: Sharing a deletion output is precisely having intersection weight I≥3: select three units from the coordinatewise minimum. Each word with a triple uses a coordinate no other such word can use for a triple, so there are at most q heavy words. For two light words x,y the coordinate maxima total at most 2q, giving I≥2n−2q≥4. Above 2q a light word cannot exist. Pure words and one capped word of the required mass (when it fits) attain the bounds. At n=q+1 the two supplied light vectors have intersection exactly 2: two opposite-half singleton overlaps for even q, or a single doubled overlap for odd q. At either rigidity length there must be exactly q heavy words assigned to different coordinates and a single light word. At 2q every light entry is 2, forcing purity of all heavy words. At 2q−1 there is precisely one light entry 1, at s, with all others 2. At an assigned coordinate other than s the two units of allowed overlap are exhausted, and at s the remaining budget of one forces at most one unit off s (each other light entry is 2). All q choices for the s-word are mutually distinct choices of codebook and compatible with the other words, and the light word distinguishes the q choices of s. This gives the stated 1 and q² counts without extrapolation.
residual_risks: The mathematical proof is uniform. The packaged computation only corroborates small parameter ranges; it does not exhaust all large codebooks.

evidence: The indexed structure explicitly gives one capped vector and exactly one heavy word assigned to each coordinate. The only capped profiles at 2q and 2q−1 are 2 everywhere or 2 except a single 1. For each assigned coordinate with light value 2, overlap ≤2 immediately forces zero elsewhere; for the coordinate with light value 1, at most one unit can lie elsewhere, so there are q choices, and choosing the singleton coordinate gives another factor q.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Those two endpoint counts follow by substituting the only possible capped vectors into the known coordinate structure and the same local intersection inequality. This is a mechanical consequence, not an additional packing theorem or an unclassified remaining shape.

evidence: Correcting at most n−3 deletions and exactly n−3 deletions are equivalent here: an output of larger cardinality shared by two inputs would contain a common size-three output. The indexed result uses the same intersection criterion. In the capped family, x↦2−x preserves ℓ¹ distance and turns the problem into a ternary constant-weight code of weight 2q−n.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The different deletion-budget wording is not a different capacity. The constant-weight equivalence supplies the light-word packing ingredient, not a separate full multiset theorem on its own.

value.rationale: The capacity phase transition is a natural exact coding invariant and would be of substance on its own. In comparison with the verified coverage, however, the only proposed increment is to count the labels of the two forced capped vectors and the at-most-one extra unit dictated by the already available structure. There is no independent additional classification of compatible codes beyond this endpoint specialization.
residual_risks: The review does not address optimizers at interior plateau lengths, which could be a different problem.
